number.why: HR 0.69 (0.36-1.32) is RE-COVER II's own major-bleeding HR. It is not the pooled RE-COVER + RE-COVER II 0.73 (which would double-count M-06), not any bleeding 0.67, and not MBE/CRBE. The registry's time-to-first-MBE analysis in the treated set matches.

quotes.span: The safety end point, major bleeding, occurred in 15 patients receiving dabigatran (1.2%) and in 22 receiving warfarin (1.7%; hazard ratio, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.36-1.32).
Pooled analysis of this study RE-COVER II and the RE-COVER trial gave hazard ratios for recurrent VTE of 1.09 (95% CI, 0.76-1.57), for major bleeding of 0.73 (95% CI, 0.48-1.11)

entry.why: Adults 18 or older with acute symptomatic proximal DVT and/or PE, dabigatran vs warfarin.
